notes: Mid-market product analytics SaaS building a semantic-search product over customer help docs and event logs. Primary evaluation is embeddings-based semantic search. Started with Hosted API test (good latency for single requests) but team wants predictable throughput and nightly batch-embedding jobs which push them toward Dedicated. Key asks: 1) throughput for real-time search queries (target p95 < 120ms for top-k vectored queries), 2) bulk embedding throughput for nightly jobs (expect ~1M docs/month, need ~200k embeddings/hr batch window), 3) easy integration with Pinecone and Milvus, 4) cost predictability and reserved pricing, 5) SSO/SAML and SOC2 proof. AE demo focused on Hosted API for quick onboarding; POC scope agreed to run a 2-week Dedicated trial (simulate 200k/hr batch and 500 qps vector queries) using customer's Pinecone cluster in VPC. SE to provision test workload and coordinate firewall/VPC peering. Customer is cost-sensitive; mentions quote: "We need to see 30-40% cost savings vs current OpenAI+Pinecone stack to commit to Dedicated." Quote from Head of Product: "If latency holds at scale and batch costs are predictable, we'll move forward."
